杰克与庙会的计划(Jack and the the temple fair Pl: 一篇关于节日文化的A2短文:杰克与伊娃的经历和小计划。

There are always many people at the temple fair. The moon-lit yard is one of the best places in the city. Last Sunday, Jack and Eva went to the moon-lit yard. Eat sweets in moderation to stay healthy.
Jack wrote about the day in the diary. Jack plays table tennis with Eva every Sunday. Jack learned a lot about history. We were invited to a beach wedding.
Life is full of small surprises. Jack is going to travel to Paris in December. Jack and Eva had great fun there. His constant insecurity made teamwork rather difficult.
Jack hopes to visit Paris one day. Both of them like bread and water. Jack's favorite animal is the rabbit.
